title: A support agent trained on a knowledge base
intro: This is a support agent that answers from help articles written for it. It shows the article it used. When no article covers a question, it hands over to a person and does not guess.
disclaimer: A working re-creation. Tabuleiro (made up), its product and its help articles are all made up.
role: Answers customers from help articles written for it, and hands over to a person when no article covers the question.

pages.title: Where to find and use your game code
pages.body: Your game code is printed on the card inside the lid of the box. Open the app, go to Settings, then Redeem, and type the code. One code works on up to five devices.

pages.title: A piece is missing or damaged
pages.body: Send us your order number and a photo of the box contents through the form in the app, under Help. We post the replacement piece free of charge within 10 working days.

pages.title: Delivery times
pages.body: Orders to the UK arrive in 2 to 4 working days. Orders to the rest of Europe arrive in 5 to 8 working days. You get a tracking link by email when the order ships.

pages.title: Which devices the app works on
pages.body: The app works on phones and tablets with iOS 15 or later, or Android 10 or later. It does not work on smart TVs.
